# Manual Blockscout verification

Blockscout's API sits behind a Cloudflare challenge that blocks CLI verification, so verify through the website:

1. Open https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/address/<ADDRESS>?tab=contract and click **Verify & publish**.
2. Method: **Solidity (Standard JSON input)**. Compiler **v0.8.28**. Upload `<Contract>.standard-input.json` from this folder.
3. Contract name: the name below. Paste the constructor arguments (Blockscout usually auto-detects them).
